examples.en: It sets targets for reduction of greenhouse-gas emissions.
examples.zh: 它为减少温室气体排放设立了目标。

examples.en: The specific impact of the greenhouse effect is unknowable.
examples.zh: 温室效应的具体影响尚不可知。

examples.en: You can make your flights carbon neutral by planting trees to make up for the greenhouse gas emissions.
examples.zh: 你可以通过种树抵消温室气体排放，这样你的飞行就可以做到碳中和。
